commits.subject: fix(harness): verify external delivery through mounted workers
fix(provider): apply physical hooks to helper streams
fix(browser): start the CDP Chrome instead of waiting for one
fix(overlay): show the macOS menubar with the accelerators AppKit installs
feat(squads): stamp a package's version when its bytes move
fix(deploy): probe and route the endpoint the site actually serves
fix(web): make the atomic-swap precondition something reset-v1 guarantees
fix(squad-sdk): bump the revision its changed bytes require
fix(overlay): keep Tauri out of style-src so packaged styles still apply
refactor(plugin): let a package name its sources by selecting them
fix(project): stop project open from failing the Task it is recovering
docs: round out the 0.0.49beta entry with what the release actually carries
